title: Sengoku Jidai - Samurai Legends
description: [1.21.1] Forge your path as a samurai in the Sengoku era of Japan.
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39a7e982bc740028f18c5d2b3d874188dedb0b61.jpeg)
# ABOUT
**Step into Sengoku Japan and become the legend your clan needs.**

This modpack is built around the **Sengoku Jidai** mod and expands Minecraft into a survival world inspired by feudal Japan. You will discover Japanese villages, castles, shrines, warriors, yokai, and dangerous lands while fighting to survive and grow stronger.

The pack keeps the vanilla Minecraft feeling, but adds more adventure, atmosphere, challenge, and quality-of-life features. Whether you want to build a peaceful Japanese village, travel as a wandering samurai, or battle mythical creatures, the world gives you a reason to explore.

[![BH](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/ca28c1bd-8c0e-4625-bda1-43965a48650c.webp)](https://bisecthosting.cwortex.com/)
# FEATURES
* Japanese-inspired world generation and structures
* Samurai, bandits, clans, and yokai
* Better combat and survival progression
* Thirst, temperature, and more immersive survival
* Storage upgrades, backpacks, waystones, and maps
* Ambient sounds, improved visuals, and useful client features
* A focused vanilla+ experience built around Sengoku Japan
* Fully Optimized with Shader Support
